about: The scripted auditor of tests/full-audit.e2e.test.ts: one verdict per RGAA criterion the worklist of tests/fixtures/full-audit-app hands over. `cite: "all"` cites every evidence anchor the worklist harvested for that criterion (copied from the worklist, never retyped); `except` leaves out the anchors a verdict does not clear; `at` names the evidence anchors an NC finding is drawn from. A criterion missing here fails the test by name, so a worklist that changes shape is seen, not silently filled.

findings.message: The opening-hours image carries information and has no text alternative.
The logo image, the only content of the home link, has no text alternative.

1.2.justification: Both images carry information (see 1.1); no image is decorative.

1.3.justification: No image carries a text alternative whose relevance could be judged; the other anchors are landmarks, not images.

1.6.justification: No image needs a detailed description: neither is a chart, a map or a diagram.

1.7.justification: No image has a detailed description.

1.8.justification: The opening-hours image file is not served, so whether it is an image of text cannot be seen; a human has to open the original asset.

1.9.justification: No image has a caption (no figure, no figcaption).

2.2.justification: No frame or iframe on any page.

3.1.justification: Every link sits in a list or keeps its default underline; no information relies on colour alone.

3.2.justification: Measured pairs: #1e1e1e and #000091 on white, white on #000091 — all above 4.5:1.

3.3.justification: The focus outline (#000091 on white) and the button background (#000091) are above 3:1 against their surroundings.

4.8.justification: No non-time-based media (no canvas, object or embed).

6.1.justification: Each named link is explicit from its own text (« Aide », « Plan du site », « page de contact »…); the unnamed logo link is a 6.2 failure.

6.2.justification: The engine proved the unnamed home link of the SiteLogo component (6.2.1); no page renders that component, and every link on the pages has a name.

7.1.justification: No page loads a script; the anchors are native landmarks and a static role=status region.

7.3.justification: No script: the only control is a native submit button.

7.4.justification: No script initiates a change of context.

7.5.justification: The service notice is a role=status region; no other message is inserted at run time.

8.1.justification: Every page, source and rendered, starts with <!doctype html>.

8.2.justification: Validity of the generated source needs a validator run on each page; none was run in this audit.

8.6.justification: Each title names the page, then the site.

8.7.justification: All content is in French: no change of language.

8.9.justification: Headings head sections and lists hold lists; no tag is used for presentation only.

9.1.justification: One h1 per page, then h2 sections, in order.

9.2.justification: header, nav, main and footer frame every page, with a skip link to main.

9.3.justification: Every list is a ul of li.

10.1.justification: Presentation comes from a stylesheet; no presentational attribute.

10.2.justification: Every piece of content is in the markup; nothing is injected by CSS.

10.3.justification: The source order (header, nav, main, footer) reads the same without CSS.

10.4.justification: Sizes are in rem and the 200 % probe found nothing.

10.5.justification: body declares both colour and background; the button declares both.

10.6.justification: Links in running text keep their default underline.

10.7.justification: A 3px #000091 outline on every focusable element; the focus probe found nothing.

10.8.justification: The off-screen skip link is meant to be read and shows on focus; nothing else is hidden.

10.9.justification: The instructions name the steps in words, never by shape or position.

10.10.justification: The instructions name the steps in words, never by shape or position.

10.11.justification: The 320px probe found no horizontal scrolling.

10.12.justification: The text-spacing probe found no loss of content.

10.13.justification: No content appears on hover or focus apart from the skip link, which stays until focus leaves.

10.14.justification: The only CSS-revealed content is the skip link, revealed on keyboard focus.

11.1.justification: The engine proved the unlabelled email field of the contact page (11.1.1); every other field, on every other page, has a label.

11.2.justification: Each existing label names its field (« Nom », « Identifiant », « Mot de passe », « Message »…).

11.3.justification: No two fields with the same function carry different labels.

11.4.justification: Each label sits right above its field.

11.5.justification: Each form is short and single-purpose: no group of same-nature fields needs a fieldset.

11.7.justification: No group of fields, so no legend.

11.9.justification: Each button says what it does (« Se connecter », « Envoyer le message », « Rechercher »…).

11.10.justification: No field is required or format-checked.

11.11.justification: No input control, so no error message to suggest from.

11.12.justification: No form has legal, financial or personal-data consequences.

findings.message: The email field asks for the user's own address and has no autocomplete="email".

12.1.justification: A main menu, a site map and a search page.

12.2.justification: Header, menu and footer appear in the same place and order on every page.

12.3.justification: The site map lists every section and each link reaches it.

12.4.justification: The footer links the site map on every page.

12.5.justification: The menu links the search page on every page.

12.6.justification: header, nav, main and footer are landmarks.

12.7.justification: A skip link to #contenu opens every page.

12.8.justification: Tab order follows the DOM, which follows the reading order.

12.9.justification: The keyboard-trap probe found nothing and no widget captures focus.

12.11.justification: No additional content on hover or focus beyond the skip link.

13.1.justification: No time limit, no refresh, no redirect.

13.2.justification: No link opens a new window.

findings.message: The paper form PDF is untagged and has no accessible version.

13.4.justification: No document offers an accessible version to compare.

13.7.justification: The image files are not served, so whether they flash cannot be seen; a human has to open the original assets.

13.9.justification: No orientation lock; the orientation probe found nothing.

13.11.justification: The only pointer action is a native button, which fires on release.

trial.about: The refuter of step 4: every claim is checked at its cited anchor and upheld, except the ones listed under `refuted`, which go back to « à évaluer » through --prune.

refuted.1.3: The cited anchors are images with no alternative and landmarks: nothing here shows the criterion is out of scope.

undecidable.about: Written to .ultra11y/undecidable-rgaa.json for `check --require-decided=pages --allow-undecided`: the criteria a human still has to rule, each with its reason.

entries.reason: The trial refuted the « non applicable » claim; a human has to rule the relevance of the alternatives once the images carry one.
The image file is not served, so whether it is an image of text needs the original asset.
Validity of the generated source needs a validator run on each page.
Ruled non-conforming on the contact page; the login and search fields of the other pages are not ruled one page at a time by a scope-wide verdict.
The image files are not served, so whether they flash needs the original assets.
